title: Daily meter readings DAG
summary: Every day at 05:30: wait for the vendor's drop in landing, copy it to raw with Data Factory, run the two Spark jobs on Databricks, build the three SQL models, check at least 50 sites have a row, then publish the day for the API.

steps.note: drop_prefix, quality_sql and publish_day are covered by tests/test_meter_readings_daily.py.

steps.title: Schedule: every day at 05:30
steps.note: No catch-up; 2 retries 10 minutes apart. The SQL files are read from the warehouse checkout.

steps.title: Wait for the drop
steps.note: Reschedule mode: the sensor frees its worker between checks, gives up after 6 hours.

steps.note: Runs pipeline pl_copy_meter_drop; its JSON is not in Git yet.

steps.note: Job meter-energy from spark-jobs/databricks.yml: clean, then daily energy.
